deviations.what: t5 criterion 2: the time-base origin is the first presented video frame's start_time, not the container start_time; later tasks convert with probe.to_source_seconds()/from_source_seconds() and never add the container start_time themselves
deviations.reason: On the VFR fixture the container start_time (1.477s, from the audio stream) precedes the first video frame (1.500s), so subtracting it literally would put the first presented frame at 0.023s, contradicting spec c50/h40 ('seconds from the first presented frame'). User approved 2026-09-30.

deviations.what: t9 writes its PNGs with its own atomic temp-file + os.link/os.replace instead of output.py's helper, and seeks with to_source_seconds(t) - container start_time to match ffmpeg 6.1's input-relative -ss clock
deviations.reason: output.plan_output plans media containers from a source and would rewrite a .png dst to .mkv; the same no-partial-file / no-overwrite guarantee (obligation o5) is kept and tested. ffmpeg's input -ss is relative to the container start_time even with -copyts (verified on this host); probe's normalized base is unchanged. User approved 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: h43/t25: an mkv (vp8+opus) cut re-encodes its audio to opus in the same container; audio is stream-copied only when the edit spans the whole file with frame-only video ops. t25 asserts same container+codec, copy only for untouched audio
deviations.reason: Trimming audio frame-accurately requires re-encoding it, so 'opus stream-copied where untouched' cannot apply to a cut (found while building t10's compiler). User approved 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: Filter-mode edits drop subtitle, attachment and data streams unless listed in 'keep' (not only when redacting); every drop is listed in the dry-run plan
deviations.reason: A cut would leave copied subtitle/attachment/data streams mistimed; c56 implied they ride along. Re-timing subtitles is out of scope. User approved 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: Reopen t19's daemon/server.py for a small fix: job completion must not clobber an output path that appeared after planning; use output.commit's no-clobber semantics (link then unlink; replace only with overwrite) plus a regression test
deviations.reason: Found by t10: server.py finishes ffmpeg jobs with os.replace(tmp_output, output), which overwrites a dst created after the dry-run even without --overwrite, breaking c43 and obligation o5. User approved the fix 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: build_index defaults verify=True: one GET /capabilities per build re-indexes when the served model changed; query-time reads (load_index/search) make zero gateway calls. o11's 'zero requests' is read as the query path
deviations.reason: o11/c48 promise both zero requests on an unchanged file and re-indexing on a model change; detecting a model change needs one capabilities call, so a verify-off default would serve stale captions after a model swap. User chose verify-on-build 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: An output path whose extension does not match the source container is refused at dry-run (input.output_container_mismatch, naming the expected extension); fix lands in output.py (t7's file) via a small fix task
deviations.reason: Found by t13: following c56 an mkv source written to out.mp4 silently produced Matroska content under a .mp4 name. User chose refuse-at-dry-run 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: Blur rectangles are widened outward to even (4:2:0) edges - at most 1px per edge, clamped to the frame - and the actual covered area is reported; black boxes stay pixel-exact
deviations.reason: ffmpeg overlay rounds x/y down to even on 4:2:0, so an odd-edged blur would shift and leave an unblurred column (a leak). Fail closed: never cover less than asked. User approved 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: Redaction time windows start one nominal frame interval (+1ms) early and end 1ms late so every frame on screen during [start,end] is covered; VFR gaps longer than the nominal interval remain a documented caveat
deviations.reason: Exact between(t,start,end) leaves the frame presented at 'start' (shown slightly earlier) uncovered; matches probe's frame-presented-at-t rule. build() is pure so it cannot probe actual VFR frame times. User approved 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: t22 additionally owns new media_cli/media/daemon/handlers.py (registers an 'index' job kind running index.build_index) plus a one-line import of it in daemon/__main__.py (t20's file)
deviations.reason: c21 requires long searches to run as daemon jobs, but the daemon process only knows the built-in 'ffmpeg' kind, so 'search index --apply' would be rejected; handlers must be registered inside the daemon process. User approved 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: Fix task edits five user-facing strings outside t23's ownership (explain/__init__.py unknown-path hint; 'see media-cli ... overview' help in _commands/cli.py, edit.py, search.py, job.py) to name the installed command 'media', and turns t23's strict-xfail guard into a normal test
deviations.reason: Obligation o17 requires every help/error hint to name the installed 'media' command; t23 could not edit files it did not own and pinned the gap with a strict xfail. User approved 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: Fix: probe's JSON exposes the editable range (normalized start 0 and end = probe.end); an edit-list end at or beyond that end (within one frame) is clamped and treated as whole-file, so frame-only edits on the full span stay passthrough with stream-copied audio
deviations.reason: Found by t25: on an mkv probe reported 10.008s (audio tail) but edit plan accepted ends only up to 10.001s (video end), probe never exposed that bound, and end=10.0 fell to filter mode and re-encoded audio, so agents could not express 'whole file'. User approved fixing now 2026-10-01.

deviations.what: Validation fixes: (1) index captioning retries a batch once on a caption-count mismatch, then captions that batch frame by frame; it still fails closed (env.sense_unavailable, nothing cached) if any single frame stays malformed. (2) The daemon socket path is checked against the AF_UNIX length limit up front, with a typed env error whose remediation says to set a shorter XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; no daemon error may carry an empty remediation
deviations.reason: Validation at 8dc0e07: the c36 live test failed because Gemma-4 returned 3 captions for a 4-frame batch of near-identical frames, aborting the whole index; and an over-long socket path produced env.daemon_unavailable with an empty remediation. User approved fixing both before the PR 2026-10-01.

deltas.behavior_text: Time base origin is the first presented video frame (not the container start_time); ffmpeg input seeks subtract the container start_time to match ffmpeg's input clock
A cut re-encodes audio (same codec/container); audio is stream-copied only for whole-file, frame-only edits
Filter-mode edits drop subtitle/attachment/data streams unless listed in keep; drops are listed in the dry-run plan
Daemon job completion never clobbers an output path that appeared after planning (input.output_exists) unless overwrite
search index build verifies the served model with one /capabilities call and re-indexes on change; the query path makes zero verify calls
An output path whose extension does not match the source container is refused at plan time (input.output_container_mismatch)
Blur rectangles widen to even 4:2:0 edges (<=1px per edge, reported as 'covered'); redaction windows start one frame interval early so the frame on screen at start is covered
The daemon runs 'index' jobs (search index --apply) via a registered handler
Every help and error hint names the installed command 'media' (prog=media)
probe --json exposes editable {start,end,frame_interval}; an end within one frame past editable.end is clamped and whole-file frame-only edits stay passthrough
Subverbs 'edit regions' (Gemma boxes + coverage), 'search purge' (dry-run first) and 'search cache' expose model-derived redaction and the purgeable/inspectable cache from the CLI

Index captioning retries a batch once on a caption-count mismatch, then captions it frame by frame (never exceeding max_calls); still fails closed if a single frame stays malformed
